vtt:
WEBVTT

00:00:20.000 --> 00:00:57.000
<v Marco Silva>Pricing on starch moved again.</v>

00:00:57.000 --> 00:01:34.000
<v Raj Mehta>Lakeshore Foods wants to lock pricing for Q1.</v>

00:01:34.000 --> 00:02:11.000
<v Dana Price>We're going with a three month lock for Lakeshore Foods.</v>

00:02:11.000 --> 00:02:48.000
<v Raj Mehta>I'll send Lakeshore Foods the Q1 price letter by Friday.</v>

00:02:48.000 --> 00:03:25.000
<v Marco Silva>Andean Ingredients is running late on PO100903.</v>

00:03:25.000 --> 00:04:02.000
<v Dana Price>Marco, can you chase Andean Ingredients on PO100903 today?</v>

00:04:02.000 --> 00:04:39.000
<v Marco Silva>Yep.</v>

00:04:39.000 --> 00:05:16.000
<v Marco Silva>I think freight is up again too.</v>

00:05:16.000 --> 00:05:53.000
<v Dana Price>We need to review the freight contract.</v>

00:05:53.000 --> 00:06:30.000
<v Raj Mehta>I'll take that.</v>

00:06:30.000 --> 00:07:07.000
<v Marco Silva>Prairie wants to quote us on pulses.</v>

00:07:07.000 --> 00:07:44.000
<v Dana Price>Okay, bye.</v>
